currentParagraphText: “Your choice has been made, and it appears that peace is not an option you are willing to explore. Very well... let us adopt a more heavy-handed approach. Apprehend the Chosen.”

finalResult.nextParagraphText: With those words, the Lodestar Patron’s projection exploded without any warning as a wave of holy light washed over Jake. Once more, it became clear the Holy Church had fully expected things could go south as the explosion from the formation directly attacked Jake’s soul, making him stumble back.
finalResult.previousParagraphText: “But it will be your doing,” the Lodestar Matron said before sighing.
